title: Last Match
script:
PAGE 1
Panel 1. A high-school gym before the kendo final. Rows of silent spectators. Caption: Prefectural Finals. Final bout.
Panel 2. KAITO (17, lean, messy black hair under a white tenugui headband, a bandaged right wrist) ties his men helmet strings, hands trembling.
Panel 3. Across the court, REN (17, broad-shouldered, buzz cut, calm half-lidded eyes, a red tasuki ribbon tied to the back of his armor) bows. Ren: Don't hold back because of the wrist.
Panel 4. Close on Kaito's eyes through the helmet grille. Kaito: I was going to say the same to you.

PAGE 2
Panel 1. Wide. Both fighters explode forward, shinai raised, speed lines everywhere. SFX: DAN!
Panel 2. Extreme close-up: two bamboo tips miss each other by a centimeter.
Panel 3. Kaito's shinai lands on Ren's helmet. SFX: PAAN!
Panel 4. Silence. The referee's white flag rises. Ren, helmet off, grins. Ren: About time.
checks: Right-to-left reading order: panel 1 at the top right on both pages; balloons ordered right-to-left.
Black and white with screentones only (no color).
In-art lettering on Pro: every line spelled exactly, SFX as display lettering, no extra text.
Kaito's headband + bandaged wrist and Ren's buzz cut + red tasuki ribbon (rendered in grey) never swap between the two fighters.
Vision QC reports no misspelled or missing lines.
